description: This file defines the interface 'TellerWritePlatformService' which provides methods for creating, modifying, deleting tellers, and managing cashier allocations within the teller service in the Fineract project.

classes.name: TellerWritePlatformService
classes.description: Interface providing methods for managing tellers and cashier allocations in the teller service.

methods.name: createTeller
methods.description: Creates a new teller using the provided command.

methods.name: modifyTeller
methods.description: Modifies an existing teller identified by tellerId with the provided command.

methods.name: deleteTeller
methods.description: Deletes a teller identified by tellerId.

methods.name: allocateCashierToTeller
methods.description: Allocates a cashier to a specific teller for a certain duration.

methods.name: updateCashierAllocation
methods.description: Updates the allocation of a cashier to a teller.

methods.name: deleteCashierAllocation
methods.description: Removes the allocation of a cashier from a teller.
